import pandas as pd

# Extract year from 'years for jazz' column
df['start_year'] = df['years for jazz'].str.extract(r'(\d{4})').astype(float)

# Filter for players after 1985 and from United States
after_1985_us = df[(df['start_year'] > 1985) & (df['nationality'] == 'united states')]

# Count total US players after 1985
total_us_after_1985 = len(after_1985_us)

# Check if Louis Amundson is in the filtered set
louis_in_set = 'louis amundson' in after_1985_us['player'].values

# Determine if both conditions are true
answer = (total_us_after_1985 == 4) and louis_in_set
